title: The amount looks wrong
story: Maria reported her part-time pay on time, but the notice counts earnings she never had.

facts.reason: your earnings were higher than we expected
facts.stated_withholding: withhold part of your monthly benefit

statements.what_happened: I reported my part-time pay by phone in January and again in March.
statements.why_wrong: The notice counts earnings I did not have. My pay stubs show a lower amount.
